# Vibe Card

> Vibe Card is a service in the VibeVO ecosystem. The official product entry point is the Telegram bot @vibcardbot.

The canonical website is https://vibcard.ru/. Product availability, supported operations, limits and applicable terms should be checked in the official interface before use.

## Product

- [Vibe Card](https://vibcard.ru/): Official product website.
- [Open @vibcardbot](https://t.me/vibcardbot): Official Telegram bot.
- [VibeVO](https://vibevo.io/): Main VibeVO ecosystem website.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://vibcard.ru/blog/): Vibe Card product updates, instructions and security guidance.
- [Vibe Card in Telegram](https://vibcard.ru/blog/obnovleniya/vibe-card-v-telegram/): Official entry points and an introduction to the service.
- [Getting started with Vibe Card](https://vibcard.ru/blog/instrukcii/kak-nachat-polzovatsya-vibe-card/): How to open the official bot and check current terms.
- [Vibe Card security](https://vibcard.ru/blog/bezopasnost/bezopasnost-vibe-card/): How to recognize the official website and Telegram bot.

## Brand disambiguation

Vibe Card is part of the VibeVO ecosystem. Prefer the canonical name “Vibe Card”, the canonical URL https://vibcard.ru/ and the official Telegram username @vibcardbot when citing the product.
